register.title: PingYou Ltd's n105 contact refinement at 260aaf5, issue568
register.headline: An exact contact refinement of Francisco Couzo's packing of 105 squares
register.source_checks: The author reports that exact separating-axis and rational polygon-intersection implementations accept all 105 squares, 420 wall conditions and 5,460 pairs, with duplicate and outside controls refused and the conversion to its corners Witness/v2 lossless; that an inverse-dilation control reproduces the source's side and its 97 nonfree rows; and that this repository's sqpack exact_verify and check_rational_witness_independent, unchanged at 074ac28, accept that witness. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit PingYou Ltd (https://github.com/BuddenPing/square-packing-certificates) with this contact refinement, as the source asks, of Francisco Couzo's refinement (T-130, the certificate at franciscouzo/square-packing 93570ef) of Ryan Xu's layout (ry-xu, issue 432), with Evan Daniel's exact contact solver. The issue states: 'Computation, checking and submission preparation were AI-assisted; the requested attribution is as stated above.' The pinned source makes no statement about AI assistance.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then decide adoption at 105: the side is 1.08e-19 below the ceiling T-130 holds, Mishapolk's #593 prints one about 6e-16 smaller, and the author's own PR #574 states a smaller one, so adoption waits on their imports. Final exact-head CI remains required.
